label: lem:topological-mass-eigenspace-decomp
title: Eigenspace decomposition of the mass integrand (descent involution)
html:
Let \alpha = (\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+) form the integrand of the mass identity for a vortex \varrho. Let \hat{\tau}_n be the descent involution. Suppose the multiplicative integral factors over the splitting \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{desc}} \oplus \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{trans}}, so that \mathrm{MI}\!\int_\Sigma \alpha = \mathrm{MI}\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) \cdot \mathrm{MI}\!\int_\Sigma (\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)). Then:

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  \le
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)
  \bigr\rVert +
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma
  \bigl(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)\bigr)
  \bigr\rVert.

Equality is not asserted. Killing-form orthogonality of the two parts does not supply it: orthogonality makes squared norms add, and two non-zero orthogonal vectors satisfy the triangle inequality strictly. Equality holds exactly when the two multiplicative integrals lie on a common ray, which is open.
heading: Lemma
